sql.query: SELECT gc.id,gc.contractName,gc.status,gc.workflowId,gc.issuedDate FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1

SELECT dc.id,dc.sourceClauseId,dc.clauseHeading,dc.clauseTextSnapshot,dc.clauseBehaviour,dc.conditionKey,dc.displayOrder,dc.isIncluded,dc.isCustom,dc.modifiedDate FROM tbl_contract_document_clauses dc INNER JOIN tbl_generated_contracts gc ON gc.id=dc.contractId AND gc.tenantId=dc.tenantId WHERE dc.contractId=:contractId AND dc.tenantId=:tenantId ORDER BY dc.displayOrder,dc.id
SELECT c.id,c.clauseName,c.clauseHtml,c.clauseBehaviour,c.conditionKey FROM tbl_contract_clauses c WHERE c.tenantId=:tenantId AND c.isActive=1 ORDER BY c.sortOrder,c.clauseName
